provenance: Authorized QuorumRelay Evaluation trial browser. Exact server-rendered form script extracted from editor; all JSON.parse record initializers removed. Requests/responses recursively redact token/password/pin/email/phone/private authentication values. No browser credentials exported.

contract.create: POST /{org}/meetings, JSON,201 raw meeting object with nativeid and canonicalurl
contract.update: POST /{org}/meetings_v2/{id}, JSON,200 raw meeting object with nativeid and changed canonicalurl
contract.authentication: Session cookie plus X-XSRF-TOKEN and X-Requested-With XMLHttpRequest
contract.numeric_detail: A single native-ID detail probe returned404; no numeric readback route is mapped.
contract.recovery: Persist returned nativeid AND exact canonicalurl; no titlematching or mutation replay. Lost response with no known URL remains uncertain.

scope: Single private unpublished no_remote meeting create/update, title/description/location/timezone/date range, no guests, no invites. Recurrence, multi-day, scheduler, video integrations, publication and import remain separate.
